title: Accounting Manager - US GAAP
description:
Lead US Accounting. Operate at a Global Standard.

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.


The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership


What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency


What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Programa Trainee Vértua: Formação de Assessores
description:
A Vértua Investimentos está selecionando novos talentos para integrar sua operação em Cascavel. Nosso Programa Trainee foi desenvolvido para quem deseja construir uma carreira sólida e de alta performance no mercado financeiro, com um caminho claro e meritocrático para se tornar sócio do escritório.

Não exigimos experiência prévia ou certificações iniciais. Nosso foco é investir no seu potencial e fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para sua ascensão profissional.


A Trilha de Desenvolvimento do Trainee:

Ingresso e Formação Técnica (ANCORD): Você entra no time com contratação imediata. A Vértua fornece o curso preparatório e todo o suporte necessário para que você obtenha a certificação ANCORD o mais rápido possível, habilitando sua atuação oficial no mercado.



Imersão Comercial (SDR): Com a certificação em mãos, você inicia sua atuação como SDR (Sales Development Representative). Esta fase é focada no desenvolvimento de habilidades de prospecção e relacionamento, aprendendo a dominar a abordagem estratégica e a psicologia do investidor.



Aceleração por Meritocracia: O programa é pautado por resultados. Ao atingir as metas estabelecidas na fase de SDR, você dobra seu salário base, marcando sua prontidão para os próximos níveis de responsabilidade.



Ascensão a Assessor de Investimentos: Após o sucesso comercial inicial, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes, atuando na gestão patrimonial e no atendimento direto a investidores.



Liderança e Partnership (Sociedade): Profissionais que demonstram excelência na entrega e capacidade de gestão ascendem à liderança de times. Na Vértua, o resultado entregue desde o primeiro dia como assessor é o critério para o ingresso no plano de sociedade, permitindo que você se torne sócio do negócio.



Requisitos do Programa:

Paixão pelo Mercado Financeiro: Este é o nosso único requisito essencial. Você não precisa saber o que é um \"CDB\" hoje, mas deve ter um interesse real em aprender e dominar o assunto.



Gosto em Aprender: O dia a dia da profissão exige conversar com pessoas constantemente. É fundamental estar aberto e disposto para construir relacionamentos profissionais, entender as dificuldades e absorver experiências.



Perfil Ambicioso: Buscamos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e desejam o crescimento acelerado que apenas o ganho variável e a sociedade podem proporcionar.


Localidade: Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cascavel/PR.



O que a Vértua oferece:

Contratação imediata com plano de carreira estruturado;

Curso preparatório para ANCORD totalmente custeado pela empresa;

Cultura de Meritocracia Radical (dobra salarial por performance);

Oportunidade real de Equity (Sociedade) baseada em resultados.


Como se candidatar:

Se você deseja transformar seu interesse pelo mercado financeiro em uma carreira de sócio em um dos escritórios que mais cresce na região, candidate-se agora!

title: Especialista de Gestão de Custos e Operações
description:
O Especialista de Gestão de Custos de Operações será responsável por estruturar, consolidar e controlar o orçamento das áreas operacionais da Privalia, atuando como ponte entre Operações e FP&A na construção do budget anual e revisões de forecast, sempre alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da companhia.


Além da governança financeira e contratual, a posição terá papel central no acompanhamento da execução orçamentária, monitorando realizado vs. orçamento, identificando desvios, analisando causa raiz e coordenando planos de correção e mitigação junto às áreas operacionais.


Será responsável por garantir disciplina financeira, previsibilidade de custos, transparência na alocação de despesas e robustez nos processos de faturamento e auditoria.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Construção de Budget e Planejamento Financeiro:

  • Atuar como principal interface entre Operações e FP&A na construção do orçamento anual e revisões periódicas de forecast;
  • Traduzir o planejamento operacional (volumes, capacidade, projetos, novos contratos) em premissas financeiras estruturadas;
  • Garantir que o budget reflita iniciativas estratégicas da companhia (eficiência, expansão, novos modelos operacionais);
  • Apoiar a construção de cenários e análises de sensibilidade para suportar tomada de decisão executiva.

Controle Orçamentário e Gestão de Desvios:

  • Monitorar continuamente orçamento vs. realizado por centro de custo, fornecedor e natureza de despesa;
  • Identificar desvios relevantes, conduzindo análises estruturadas de causa raiz;
  • Coordenar planos de ação com as áreas operacionais para correção e mitigação de riscos financeiros;
  • Garantir previsibilidade de gastos e disciplina na execução orçamentária.

Planejamento e Controle de Custos:

  • Consolidar custos das áreas operacionais, assegurando consistência entre dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Identificar tendências, oportunidades estruturais de eficiência e alavancas de melhoria de margem;
  • Suportar decisões estratégicas com análises financeiras robustas e orientadas a dados.

Governança de Faturamento e Pagamentos:

  • Padronizar e centralizar o processo de recebimento, validação e aprovação de faturas;
  • Garantir aderência contratual, acuracidade e rastreabilidade de 100% das despesas operacionais;
  • Implementar mecanismos automatizados e auditáveis de validação de custos;
  • Atuar preventivamente na identificação de inconsistências ou riscos financeiros.

Gestão Contratual e Penalidades:

  • Monitorar a execução dos contratos de fornecedores, assegurando cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras;
  • Garantir aplicação correta de penalidades e descontos contratuais, de forma independente das áreas operacionais;
  • Apoiar revisões contratuais sob a ótica de equilíbrio financeiro e mitigação de riscos.

Análise de Dados e Sistemas:

  • Desenvolver dashboards e KPIs financeiros que integrem visão operacional e orçamentária;
  • Estruturar modelo de gestão à vista de custos (budget, forecast, realizado, savings);
  • Apoiar evolução de sistemas e automações para reconciliação, auditoria e controle de despesas.

Projetos e Melhoria Contínua:

  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria na governança financeira das operações;
  • Apoiar financeiramente novos projetos, expansões e mudanças de modelo operacional;
  • Garantir correta integração financeira em novos contratos e fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em controle de custos operacionais, FP&A ou finanças aplicadas a operações/logística;
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de budget e acompanhamento de execução orçamentária;

  • Conhecimento em contratos, compliance financeiro e aplicação de penalidades contratuais;
  • Experiência em conciliação de faturas e auditoria financeira;
  • Perfil estruturado, orientado a dados, com visão crítica e capacidade de influenciar áreas operacionais;
  • Capacidade de articulação entre Operações, FP&A, Contabilidade e fornecedores;
  • Inglês e espanhol avançados/fluentes desejável.

title: Analista de Marketing
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão:


Executar as estratégias de marketing e comunicação, garantindo padronização da marca, suporte às áreas internas e entrega consistente de materiais, eventos e ações comerciais, alinhado às diretrizes corporativas.

title: Técnico de Eletromecânica (1º e 2º turnos)
description:
Quem é a Urbem ?

Unindo tecnologia e industrialização a uma matéria-prima renovável, trazemos para o Brasil a madeira engenheirada, alternativa construtiva que contribui para solucionar as dores da construção civil. Estamos falando de um canteiro de obras mais produtivo, previsível, sem geração de resíduos, mais rápido e seguro. Já pensou?


Somos a face de uma nova relação entre empresas, meio ambiente e pessoas. Com projetos íntegros, que nascem no campo e constroem nossas cidades.


Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão a partir de compromissos que impulsionam o desenvolvimento humano sustentável, a criatividade e a inovação.


Nosso ambiente é diverso, onde pessoas de todos os gêneros, raça, idade, orientação sexual e com deficiência escolhem para se desenvolver como pessoa e profissional.


O que esperamos de você?

Estamos em busca de pessoas para serem protagonistas de uma nova dinâmica que

conecta florestas a cidades. Que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Temos certeza que uma de nossas oportunidades vai dar um “match” com você!


Confira abaixo as as atividades que estão sob a repsonsabilidade da posição de Técnico de Eletromecânica :

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em máquinas e equipamentos eletromecânicos;
  • Executar montagem, instalação e ajustes de sistemas elétricos e mecânicos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas em componentes elétricos, eletrônicos, pneumáticos e mecânicos;
  • Interpretar diagramas elétricos, esquemas mecânicos e manuais técnicos;
  • Efetuar testes de funcionamento e performance dos equipamentos;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar processos de melhoria contínua e automação;
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas periódicas;
  • Executar alinhamentos, ajustes, lubrificação e substituição de componentes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas de segurança e procedimentos técnicos;
  • Registrar atividades de manutenção em sistemas ou relatórios.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Formação técnica em Eletromecânica, Eletrotécnica (com experiência mecânica) ou Mecânica (com experiência elétrica);
  • Vivência no ramo de manutenção industrial;
  • Desejável conhecimentos em motores elétricos e redutores, sistemas pneumáticos e hidráulicos e leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com áreas operacionais;
  • Proatividade e foco em soluções práticas;
  • Organização e disciplina técnica;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Compromisso com segurança e qualidade.


E aí, vamos construir as cidades do futuro, juntos?

Vem ser URBEM.

title: ENGENHEIRO (A) DE PRODUÇÃO PLENO
description:
Pioneirismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.


Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal.

Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.


Como você poderá contribuir?


Acompanhar cotidianamente a operação elaborando relatórios e auxiliando na gestão operacional da planta e resolução de problemas.


Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para esta posição?


Elaborar/revisar procedimentos operacionais, bem como realizar o treinamento da equipe e assegurar o desdobramento para todos os níveis;


Monitorar e atualizar KPI’s de gestão a vista;


Dar suporte à coordenação nas atividades operacionais cotidianas;


Dar suporte à coordenação na resolução de problemas como anomalias de processo e tratamento de não conformidades por meio de análises técnicas;


Participar ativamente dos DDS;


Participar ativamente de Programas de Melhoria Contínua;


Realizar testes na área operacional;


Realizar inspeções diárias na área operacional;


Analisar a operação diária, sugerindo modificações quando necessário;


Elaborar relatórios técnicos;


Participar das reuniões de programação de manutenção da planta;


Contribuir para capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe, mediante

levantamento de necessidades de treinamento, realizando treinamentos “in company” e/ou apresentação de sugestões para treinamentos externos;


Quais os requisitos?


Superior completo em Engenharia de Minas, Metalúrgica, Química ou Produção.

Diferencial: Vivencia com beneficiamento mineral, de preferência com operações unitárias que envolvam os processos de Peneiramento, Filtragem, Espessamento e Bombeamento.


Esta oportunidade está aberta também para pessoas com deficiência, mulheres e grupos prioritários, em conformidade com os princípios de inclusão e equidade.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).

  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.

  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: SDET Engineer (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly is seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated tests for our consumer-facing web applications, internal tools, and services. You will help modernize our end-to-end testing ecosystem by creating new Playwright-based test suites and migrating legacy Cypress tests into our new automation framework. This role is ideal for someone who loves building robust automation, improving engineering velocity, and partnering closely with developers to ship high-quality software. 
Responsibilities 
  • Develop scalable and maintainable test automation for web applications and APIs using Playwright. 
  • Convert and modernize existing Cypress test suites into Playwright, including both end-to-end tests and smoke tests.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to ensure test coverage, quality standards, and automation best practices across the stack. 
  • Work with applications built on Next.js (front-end), NestJS (back-end), and AWS cloud services. 
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, refactoring, and automation workflows.
  • Contribute to the overall testing strategy—framework enhancements, CI/CD integration, and test reliability improvements
  • Investigate failures, troubleshoot issues across distributed systems, and ensure high-quality releases. 
Qualifications 
  • 3+ years of experience as an SDET, QA Automation Engineer, or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in Playwright for test automation. 
  • Experience with Cypress and comfort migrating tests or frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript/TypeScript. 
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications and RESTful APIs.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

title: Arquiteto(a) de Segurança – CyberArk Secrets

O profissional será o referencial técnico para decisões arquiteturais relacionadas a secrets management, garantindo aderência a boas práticas de segurança, requisitos de compliance e padrões corporativos do cliente.

  • Definir e manter a arquitetura de CyberArk Secrets Manager (Conjur) para ambientes on-premises, cloud ou híbridos.

  • Definir padrões técnicos, modelos de integração e boas práticas para consumo de segredos por aplicações.

  • Apoiar processos de auditoria e conformidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e governança no uso de credenciais.

  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente e, quando necessário, junto ao fabricante.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com CyberArk Secrets Manager / CyberArk Conjur.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de segurança de aplicações e gerenciamento de segredos.
  • Experiência com DevSecOps, integração em pipelines CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Conhecimento em integração de aplicações (ex.: Java, .NET, APIs, microsserviços).
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de IAM, PAM, autenticação, autorização e criptografia.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de código para apoiar integrações.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, com foco em segurança, compliance e auditoria.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Vivência em projetos de modernização de aplicações ou migração para DevSecOps.
  • Conhecimento de containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certificações em CyberArk ou Segurança da Informação (desejável).

title: Operador(a) de Área - Água e Efluentes
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Sobre a Função


Desafios:

Liderar e executar as atividades operacionais nas áreas de tratamento de Água (captação, tratamento primário, tratamento secundário, desmineralização), Efluentes (tratamento primário e secundário) e no sistema de Emissário (operação, monitoramento e resposta a emergências), garantindo o funcionamento otimizado, seguro, contínuo e ambientalmente correto dos equipamentos e processos, atuando como referência técnica para a equipe operacional de campo, participando ativamente da análise de desvios, propondo e implementando melhorias nos procedimentos operacionais e nos equipamentos, e assegurando a conformidade com as normas ambientais.


Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar sistemas de tratamento de água, efluentes e emissário, garantindo eficiência e conformidade ambiental;
  • Controlar processos e interpretar dados operacionais, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar inspeções preventivas e preditivas em equipamentos, assegurando confiabilidade operacional;
  • Atuar na análise e solução de falhas, utilizando metodologias de causa raiz e implementando ações corretivas;
  • Apoiar/operar sistemas automatizados (SDCS) e substituir operador de painel quando necessário;
  • Liderar equipes de campo em situações operacionais e emergenciais, garantindo segurança e desempenho;
  • Contribuir na elaboração e revisão de procedimentos operacionais e ambientais;
  • Interagir com áreas de apoio (manutenção, laboratório, engenharia, meio ambiente), promovendo soluções integradas;
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho (consumo, eficiência, qualidade), propondo otimizações e redução de custos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica, apoiando o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade, meio ambiente e compliance;
  • Participar de iniciativas de melhoria contínua e projetos de otimização de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso técnico de Papel e Celulose, Química, Saneamento, Automação Industrial, Meio Ambiente e/ou afins;
  • Conhecimento em Integração de Segurança e normas de segurança do trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Domínio dos processos de tratamento de água e efluentes, incluindo tecnologias como osmose reversa, desmineralização e tratamento biológico avançado;
  • Conhecimento na operação e manutenção de equipamentos (bombas, sistemas de controle de fluxo e instrumentos de monitoramento ambiental);
  • Conhecimento em controle de qualidade da água e efluentes, incluindo parâmetros de monitoramento;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de automação industrial (SDCD), operação e interpretação de processos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de falhas (RCA) e metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Kaizen);
  • Conhecimento de normas e procedimentos ambientais aplicáveis a emissários;
  • Disponibilidade para residir e atuar em Inocência/MS;
  • CNH categoria B.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.


Key responsibilities:


- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.


Requirements:


- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

O que oferecemos:

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable


Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)


Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence


What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - DataHub
description:
Vaga - Engenheira de Dados Sênior - 100% Remoto.
Sobre o Time
O time de Data Hub do Banco Carrefour é o núcleo de dados para o Centro de Excelência de Martech, e é responsável por construir e manter a infraestrutura de dados que alimenta as decisões estratégicas do time. Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados que seja apaixonada por construir pipelines de dados robustos, escaláveis e eficientes, com experiência em ambientes cloud e familiaridade com o universo de dados de marketing e digital analytics. Se você é proativo, adora desafios e tem sede de aprendizado, essa vaga é para você!
No Seu Dia-a-dia
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) para integrar dados de diversas fontes, incluindo plataformas de marketing, digital analytics e outras fontes de dados internas e externas.
  • Otimizar a performance e a escalabilidade dos pipelines de dados.
  • Monitorar a qualidade dos dados e implementar soluções para garantir a acurácia e a consistência dos dados.
  • Colaborar com outras equipes (Data Science, Business Intelligence, Marketing) para entender as necessidades e garantir que a infraestrutura de dados atenda às demandas do negócio.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de engenharia de dados.
  • Participar ativamente da definição da arquitetura de dados e da escolha de novas tecnologias.
  • Implementar práticas de DataOps para garantir a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a governança dos dados.
Requisitos /Competências Técnicas
  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) utilizando ferramentas como Python, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow ou similares.
  • Background em Google Cloud Plataform (GCP)
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência sólida com plataformas de cloud computing, principalmente com GCP e serviços de dados (e.g., Dataflow, Dataproc, S3, Azure Data Lake Storage).
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e design de data warehouses e data lakes.
  • Experiência com plataformas de dados como BigQuery, Snowflake e Databricks
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Background com dados de Marketing e/ou Digital Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Plataformas de mídia, CRM, etc).
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com Dataform e/ou DBT
  • Experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Airflow, Dagster ou FPrefect.
  • Contribuições para projetos open source relacionados a dados.
  • Certificações em plataformas de cloud computing (GCP, AWS, Azure).
Informações Adicionais
  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Modelo de Atuação: Home Office.
Benefícios
  • R$500,00 de Ajuda de Custo mensal.
